**A Metamodern Guide to Politics** : Book One, by Hanzi Freinacht

I was drawn to this book for a number of reasons. For one thing, politics and philosophy are two of my favorite topics.

...

Until I read this book, I didn’t really have an answer to that question. Looking at our current political shenanigans and extrapolating forward, it’s hard to see what lies on the road ahead;

...

Hanzi Freinacht provides a different, and much more uplifting answer: what’s next is something he calls “metamodernism” — a political and cultural stage of development that comes after postmodernism.

In the author’s model of history, human civilization has progressed through a sequence of “developmental stages”: Archaic, Animist, Faustian, Post-Faustian, Modern, Postmodern and now Metamodern. For example, the “Faustian” stage is the one in which humans invent agriculture, and form hierarchical, pyramidal social organizations in which it is possible for ambitious humans to quest for power over others.

...

Metamodernism is exactly this — it’s an effort to reconstruct modernism with an awareness of all the critiques of postmodernism. In fact, one of the foundational ideas of metamodernism is that it embraces rather than rejects _all_ of the previous development stages.

Metamodernism is also a critique of postmodernism — that is, it’s a deconstruction of a deconstruction.

Freinacht's writing is organized around a planned sequence of Metamodern Guide to Politics books plus essays and shorter works. The published core currently consists of:
* The Listening Society: A Metamodern Guide to Politics, Book One (2017). This is the foundational statement of the listening-society program: a proposal that politics in affluent democracies should address psychosocial development, not only material welfare.
* Nordic Ideology: A Metamodern Guide to Politics, Book Two (2019). This sequel moves from diagnosis to political architecture. It treats the Nordic welfare-state tradition as a partial prototype and asks what a next-stage welfare society might add.
